en: Sepia-toned panoramic postcard showing a dense European town on a riverbank. In the foreground a stone bridge crosses the river. Behind the riverside houses rise larger late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century buildings, including a prominent school complex labeled 'Realgymnasium'. The town extends toward low hills and industrial chimneys on the horizon. The caption at the top right reads 'Meißen r.'
